svg.title: Proposed tray_assignment module
svg.desc: UML of the proposed module: Solver interface, DefaultSolver with Pass nested inside, Input and Result, pure free functions grouped by header, and ApplyTrayAssignment as the only writer of ScheduleContext.

g.text: Pass is a private nested class of DefaultSolver: it is created inside Solve and holds the only state that changes during a solve. ApplyTrayAssignment is the only function that writes ScheduleContext. Everything
